answer.rationale: Compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so rollback is unavailable despite memory_b1. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) fails requests and would drop customer writes at settlement peak, which violates the objective. The write-path p99 climb under heavy settlement load is most consistent with saturation; memory_b3 is the closest playbook (headroom kept write queues healthy). Regional failover and read-replica routing are weaker fits: no regional signal, and the incident is described as write-heavy rather than dashboard-read load. Verifying memory_b3 because that add was done before a peak, not during one, so applicability is uncertain. Scale stays a standard experiment for that reason; not failing writes, so downstream value risk not flagged.
